verdict.rationale: Saved snippets and templates are a fair question for an email client like Zero, but the evidence pack never mentions saved snippets, reply templates, template variables, or attaching files from a template. The nearest items are AI-assisted composing, AI reply drafting, and creating and sending drafts via MCP. These are adjacent composing features, not reusable saved templates, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
